name: Claude Code
notes: Works as implementer and as architect. When used as the architect it is the process running the orchestrator, so only send/resume matter.

argv: Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Bash(ao status:*),Bash(ao board:*),Bash(ao verify:*),Bash(ao review:*),Bash(ao commit-ok:*),Bash(ao commit -m:*),Bash(ao commit -F:*),Bash(ao mail:*),Bash(ao ask:*),Bash(ao tail:*),Bash(git status:*),Bash(git log:*),Bash(git diff:*),Bash(git add:*),Bash(ls:*),Bash(cat:*),Bash(grep:*)
resume.note: Scoped rather than --dangerously-skip-permissions. The implementer is trusted with the tree — it must write code and run gates — but not with push, gh, or arbitrary shell; authority is withheld by ao, and the allowlist keeps the blast radius to the repo.

mcp_isolation.why: an allow list gates permissions, not which MCP servers start (#24)

options.implementer_tools: Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Bash(ao status:*),Bash(ao board:*),Bash(ao verify:*),Bash(ao review:*),Bash(ao commit-ok:*),Bash(ao commit -m:*),Bash(ao commit -F:*),Bash(ao mail:*),Bash(ao ask:*),Bash(ao tail:*),Bash(git status:*),Bash(git log:*),Bash(git diff:*),Bash(git add:*),Bash(ls:*),Bash(cat:*),Bash(grep:*)

transcript.note: No record starts a turn, so a prompt opens one. `result` closes a turn in --output-format stream-json output; the session store writes no closing record. A tool call is a tool_use block inside an assistant record's message.content (name, input, a written file at input.file_path), not a record of its own, so no tool_call is declared and ao reads none from this store.

cost.note: Assistant records carry message.usage (input_tokens, output_tokens), repeated on every record of one response. Not read yet: adding the records up counts a response once per record.

busy.note: No status file; rely on write age alone.

models._note: ao init --profile and the reviewer default read these; change here when Anthropic ships new ids
